Op. 7055B54 PROTECTION/GUARD UNDER ENGINE - R.R.

The front wheel geometry should be checked after having subjected the components which affect the wheel geometry to the following checks:

tyre inflation pressure;

the eccentricity and the orthogonality of the wheel rims should not exceed 3 mm;

wheel bearings end float;

clearance between steering knuckle and track control arm ball joint;

steering rod ball joint clearance.

Toe-in check:

Carry out the preliminary checks on the vehicle and remove any loads transported.

Position the vehicle (in running order) on the lift with test equipment.

Check that the toe-in (1a-1b) is within the recommended limits.

The toe-in values refer to a vehicle in standard 0 and standard A.

Standard 0 = unladen vehicle including spare wheel, tools, accessories and fluids (with 5 litres of fuel).

Standard A = unladen vehicle including spare wheel, tools, accessories and suppiles (full fuel tank).

If the toe-in is not within the recommended limits, adjust it following the instructions given below.

Toe-in adjustment:

Straighten the steering wheel and lock it in position using a suitable tool.

Loosen the bands securing the boots to the steering rods.

Loosen the nuts securing the adjustable steering rods.

Tighten or loosen the steering box rods until the toe-in value is correct, keeping the front wheels aligned.
